headline: Approved conditional licenses and permits for Sugar House Hotel, Treetops, MOSS Café & Bar, and McKee's Original.
summary: The consent agenda covered license items for four businesses: Sugar House Hotel, Treetops, MOSS Café & Bar, and McKee's Original. The Vermont Department of Liquor and Lottery recommended multiple licenses at 111 Winooski Falls Way, and the mayor reminded businesses about outdoor seating and ADA requirements. All consent agenda items were approved in one 4-0 vote.
decisions: Approved the consent agenda of conditional licenses and permits for Sugar House Hotel, Treetops, MOSS Café & Bar, and McKee's Original, by a 4-0 vote.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion to approve the Liquor Control Board Consent Agenda made by Councilor Turkos and seconded by Deputy Mayor Oakleaf. Motion passed 4-0.
